requirements.requirement: The system must include unit tests validating that specialty match reasoning is always ordered before any quality-based reasoning.
The system must include unit tests verifying that providers with a specialty match are marked correctly as pass or fail based on backend data.
The system must include UI tests confirming that the pass state renders a visible pass indicator and associated explanation.
The system must include UI tests confirming that the fail state renders a visible fail indicator and associated explanation.
The system must include UI tests validating correct rendering of partial data states where some reasoning fields are present and others are missing.
The system must include UI tests validating graceful handling and display when all reasoning data is missing.
The system must include tests verifying that specialty explanation text is visible by default when present.
The system must include tests verifying that expandable reasoning sections correctly toggle visibility on user interaction.
The system must include unit tests validating that missing specialty data does not break ordering logic and still renders remaining reasoning.
The system must include tests verifying that incorrect or malformed triage API responses are handled without UI crashes.
The system must include tests ensuring that reasoning blocks are rendered in consistent order across multiple provider results.
The system must include tests verifying that the UI does not display duplicate reasoning blocks when duplicate data is received.
